repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

body: This thankfully doesn't appear to affect system catalog (using `yb-admin compact_sys_catalog`).
The root cause is the same as that of https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/13317. @frozenspider is working on it.

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-3988](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-3988)
### Description

Enable test `TablegroupCompactionWithRestart` in `pg_mini-test.cc` since issue #12898 is resolved. This test checks that after restart, there is no data loss in compaction.
